## Frequently asked questions

### Where is Diha Multispeciality Clinic?
No 6, 6th Main Road, Nanganallur, Chennai 600 061.

### What facilities does Diha Multispeciality Clinic have?
Internal medicine, Diabetology, Orthopaedics, Obstetrics & gynaecology, Cardiology, Dermatology, ENT, Urology, Physiotherapy, DGCA approved medicals, Preventive health check-ups, ECG · Echo · TMT, X-ray · Ultrasound, Laboratory, Pharmacy, Home blood tests & physiotherapy.

### Do you do DGCA medicals?
Yes. Diha Clinic offers DGCA approved medicals.

### How do I book an appointment at Diha Multispeciality Clinic?
